message.text: I'm noting that MemoService runs over both gRPC and Connect, with REST access likely handled via grpc-gateway translating to the same underlying protocol. I should look into the server setup files to confirm this.

I notice MemoService is registered twice in v1.go - once for the gRPC-Gateway and once through Connect handlers. I should check connect_handler.go to see how MemoServiceHandler is registered there too.

q19.

`MemoService` is exposed over two protocols, both wired up inside `APIV1Service.RegisterGateway` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`:

- **gRPC-Gateway (REST/JSON over HTTP)** — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (`v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s)`, line 108, mounted at `/api/v1/*`)
- **Connect (ConnectRPC, used by the web frontend)** — `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` (`apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...)` registered inside `RegisterConnectHandlers`, line 40), which is wired in via `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (`connectHandler.RegisterConnectHandlers(...)`, line 141, mounted at `/memos.api.v1.*`)
